items.title: Migrate to a C:\ QI project root
items.detail: The project still lives under C:\Users\renne\Downloads\DIGITIZATION COSTS. Move it to a proper C:\ root with the QI standard 7-folder layout (engine/config/data/logs/tests/docs/tools) and update the registry path. Flagged in qi_registry.json family_notes as 'migration pending'.

items.title: Run qi_validator against the project
items.detail: Once migrated, run python C:\QIH\ecosystem\qi_validator.py --project digitization to confirm folder layout and naming compliance. The github remote (Quiddity-Innovations/DigitizationCostTool) is already registered.

items.title: Replace the PaperVision assumption with BU's real contract
items.detail: s_pv_month defaults to $240/mo, an assumption — capture-software licensing is quote-only. Substitute BU's actual PaperVision (or equivalent capture) contract cost so hybrid Scenario B is precise.

items.title: Calibrate planning factors against real projects
items.detail: Throughput rates, internal-effort hours, the 15% rework factor, and the timeline assumptions are Document Imaging & Services estimates. Tune them against completed digitization projects so the durations and labor totals reflect observed performance.

items.title: Annual rate re-verification
items.detail: Re-verify vendor rates each year against SecureScan / Record Nations / Emerald and refresh BU student wages when the SEO Job Classification Guide or the Massachusetts minimum wage changes.

items.title: Host behind real BU authentication
items.detail: The BU_INTERNAL_ONLY flag is a presentation label, not security. For a genuinely internal build, host the file on a BU-login-gated web page or a permissioned SharePoint site rather than relying on the banner.

items.title: Document the SharePoint embed path
items.detail: A raw .html in a SharePoint library opens but its buttons do nothing (SharePoint blocks page JavaScript). Provide and document the web-server-hosted URL to embed instead, so departments don't hit a dead tool.

items.title: Save / load named project estimates
items.detail: Today only the last-used inputs persist. Let staff save multiple named estimates (per department/project) and reload them for comparison or revision.

items.title: Export results to spreadsheet
items.detail: Add an Export-to-CSV/XLSX of the computed line items and comparison so the numbers can drop straight into a budget workbook, complementing the existing PDF report.

items.title: On-site vendor crew scenario
items.detail: Vendors also offer on-site scanning crews (premium, quote-based). The tech notes say to model this by assigning scanning to the vendor and raising the rate — promote it to a first-class scenario option with its own line.

items.title: Regression tests over the cost model
items.detail: test_smoke.py only checks build artifacts. Add tests that pin calc() outputs for known input profiles (e.g. the 15-box worked example) so a future edit can't silently change the math.
